title: X03 Stage-B: review-gated run-phase reservation recalibration (shape-aware measured envelope + capped child GDAL cache), enabling the measured 12x2 run shape; pre-registered B0 large-shape calibration probe, then E2E bitwise A/B vs the x01_b1 anchor
frozen_before_timing: 2026-10-16, committed before the B0 probe submission and before any Stage-B implementation or timing; implementation lands only after B0 fixes the coefficients AND the independent review approves the diff

basis.stage_a: evidence/phase2_x03_stage_a_findings.json (job 14098252): child peak RSS 0.72-0.77 GiB at every shape vs 9.17 GiB priced; wave makespans 3x8/4x6/6x4 = 314.9/324.9/342.5 s
basis.stage_a2: evidence/phase2_x03_stage_a2_findings.json (retry job 14098987): wave_8x3 = 379.4 s, wave_12x2 = 415.7 s, engine_1x3 = 301.7 s, engine_1x2 = 347.9 s; 24-tile engine makespans 12x2=831 s < 8x3=1138 s < 6x4=1370 s < 4x6=1949 s < 3x8=2519 s; every arm TMRT bitwise 24/24
basis.gate_structure: the run phase's single memory gate is plan_phase_admission(..., policy='reject') (api.py run_utci_tiles); worker shape is caller policy (RuntimeOptions workers/threads_per_worker), so repricing simulation_reservation is the ONLY product change needed to admit 12x2

part_b0_calibration_probe.purpose: fix the envelope coefficients on measurement at a second shape and validate near-linear pixel scaling; diagnostic only, accepts no product change
part_b0_calibration_probe.scene: copy of the corpus generator (synthetic_target/gen/generate_corpus.py, corpus generator_sha256 a79439cc258e1e3a5a1e9b4d8a17ee3031fd388fd1510ac38afcad3a41b73466) with SIZE=2048 and a 1x1 grid, same fixed seed; driver sha256 recorded in the job log before timing; metfile byte-copied from the corpus dated variant

arms.rss_2048_1x8: one 2048^2/153-patch run at threads_per_worker=8; child ru_maxrss + seams (primary calibration point)
arms.rss_2048_1x2: same tile at threads_per_worker=2 (the 12x2 shape condition); also the bitwise cross-check arm

part_b0_calibration_probe.integrity_gate: no stored reference exists at 2048^2, so the gate is a same-input cross-thread comparison: TMRT_2048 from 1x2 must equal 1x8 bitwise 24/24 (detects shape-dependent nondeterminism); additionally the run must complete with no error and a sane day/night engine split
part_b0_calibration_probe.rules: one-job allocation (24 cores, 96G), shared NUMBA_CACHE_DIR, untimed prime, input sha asserts, no-retry except a documented driver anomaly (campaign rule)
part_b0_calibration_probe.fit_rule: per-child peak RSS points R1024 (max over all Stage-A/A2 arms, 0.77 GiB) and R2048 (max over B0 arms): s = (R2048 - R1024) / (3 * P1024); f = max(R1024 - s * P1024, 256 MiB floor); if the floor clamps f, raise s to max((R1024 - f)/P1024, (R2048 - f)/(4*P1024)); round s up to whole bytes/pixel and f up to whole MiB; record the fit and all raw points in the findings
part_b0_calibration_probe.no_go: if R2048 > 4.5 * R1024 (grossly super-linear) the slope form is replaced by alternative A (per-shape measured table with explicit safety margin per entry) and the protocol is amended before implementation

part_b0_retry_and_no_go.first_attempt: job 14099620 (TIMEOUT 01:00:14): the job script had no --time, so the partition's default 1-hour walltime killed the rss_2048_1x2 arm. The rss_2048_1x8 arm completed VALIDLY before the kill: wall 1360.5 s, engine 1091.9 s (~4x the 1024^2 engine: linear in pixels), child peak RSS 3.588 GiB, no error. Partials preserved under raw phase2/aborted_14099620/ with manifest.
part_b0_retry_and_no_go.causal_retry_basis: documented infrastructure anomaly (missing walltime directive, not an undesired measurement); campaign one-causal-retry rule; the retry is the same frozen arms with an explicit --time=2:00:00
part_b0_retry_and_no_go.no_go_triggered: R2048/R1024 = 3.588/0.77 = 4.66 > 4.5: the frozen no-go fires. The measured scaling is only mildly super-linear (16% over ideal 4x), but the slope form cannot satisfy both the 1024^2 tightness and the 2048^2 coverage without over-pricing 1024^2 by ~4.7x (which would push 12x2 past the observed 36.68 GB live budget: 12 x ~3.63 GB = 43.6 GB). Per the frozen rule the recalibration uses ALTERNATIVE A: a per-shape measured envelope table.
part_b0_retry_and_no_go.amended_recalibration_form: simulation_reservation total := for the first table entry with entry_pixels >= pixels: ceil(MARGIN x ENVELOPE_TABLE[entry_pixels]) + min(default_gdal_cache_bytes(), GDAL_CHILD_CACHE_CAP_BYTES) + pulse + export stream (if export_overlap) + mapped (native_cache); pixels > 2048^2: the LEGACY full-plane envelope unchanged (conservative by construction). ENVELOPE_TABLE = {1024^2: max measured per-child peak RSS across all Stage-A/A2 arms (0.77 GiB, n~40 children, all shapes and thread counts), 2048^2: max measured across the B0 retry arms}. Reservation inventory: payload = 0, live = the table envelope, decoded = 0, native = 0 (subsumed, documented), gdal_cache = capped, pulse/stream/mapped as today.
part_b0_retry_and_no_go.table_safety: step function non-decreasing in pixels (I2); at every calibrated shape price >= MARGIN x measured (I1) by construction; between entries the NEXT LARGER entry prices the shape (over-price, safe direction: RSS grows with pixels so a 1500^2 tile's true RSS is below the 2048^2 measurement); small tiles price at the 1024^2 entry, still a relaxation vs the legacy full-plane model; capacity at 1024^2: 12 x (3 x 0.77 GiB + 0.25 GiB + ~0.13 GiB) = 12 x 2.69 GB = 32.3 GB < 36.25 GB (smallest observed base) -> I4 holds; login-scale refusal preserved (I3 arithmetic unchanged, price ~2.69 GB > base ~1.8 GB)
part_b0_retry_and_no_go.b0_fit_rule_replacement: the fit_rule (slope/fixed) is REPLACED by table-entry extraction: record max per-child ru_maxrss per calibrated shape; no fit is computed. The cross-thread TMRT bitwise gate (1x2 vs 1x8) and all other B0 rules are unchanged.
part_b0_retry_and_no_go.frozen_before_timing: committed before the retry job submission

part_recalibration.change_under_test: AMENDED by part_b0_retry_and_no_go (no-go 4.66 > 4.5): simulation_reservation (runtime_memory.py) uses a MEASURED ENVELOPE TABLE, not the slope form: total := for the first table entry with entry_pixels >= pixels, ceil(MARGIN * ENVELOPE_TABLE[entry_pixels]) + min(default_gdal_cache_bytes(), GDAL_CHILD_CACHE_CAP_BYTES) + pulse + export stream (if export_overlap) + mapped (native_cache mode); pixels above the largest entry: legacy full-plane envelope unchanged. Reservation inventory fields remain populated: payload = 0, live = the table envelope, decoded = 0 and native = 0 (subsumed in the measured envelope, documented), gdal_cache = capped, pulse/stream/mapped as today; docstring cites the Stage-A/A2/B0 evidence and the redefinition

ENVELOPE_TABLE.1024*1024: max measured per-child peak RSS across Stage-A/A2 arms (0.77 GiB)
ENVELOPE_TABLE.2048*2048: max measured across B0 retry arms

part_recalibration.child_env_change: runtime._child_environment GDAL_CACHEMAX := min(default_gdal_cache_bytes(), GDAL_CHILD_CACHE_CAP_BYTES) // MiB for ALL child phases, so the permitted per-child envelope equals the priced envelope by construction (an LRU byte ceiling, not a value-affecting knob)
part_recalibration.margin_rationale: 3x covers per-shape/condition variation (0.72-0.77 GiB spread), uncalibrated windchannel deltas, and preserves login-node refusal: at the observed login view (~2.2 GB budget, 0.43 GB parent, ~110 MB gdal) the recalibrated 1024^2 price (~2.6-2.7 GB) still exceeds the reservation base (~1.8 GB), while at 2x the price (~1.9-2.0 GB) is marginal
part_recalibration.capacity_arithmetic: 12 x (MARGIN x ~0.77 GiB + 256 MiB + pulse/stream ~130 MiB) ~= 12 x 2.69 GB ~= 32.3 GB < every observed compute-node live budget (36.68 GB smallest, X01 E2E) and < 47-50.8 GB typical; 8x3 and 6x4 fit with more headroom; a 2048^2 job prices ~3x R2048 + terms and refuses 12-wide on a 47 GB node (conservative by construction)

invariants_with_tests.I1: total >= MARGIN x measured per-child peak RSS at every calibrated point (1024^2: 0.77 GiB; 2048^2: B0 max)
invariants_with_tests.I2: monotone non-decreasing in pixels and patches (property test)
invariants_with_tests.I3: login-scale refusal preserved: synthetic small-view unit test (budget ~2.2 GB) refuses one 1024^2/153 simulation job with ResourceAdmissionError
invariants_with_tests.I4: 12 concurrent 1024^2/153 jobs fit inside a 36 GB budget minus parent (admission plan succeeds)
invariants_with_tests.I5: reject semantics unchanged: policy='reject' raises ResourceAdmissionError with the unchanged message shape; empty-jobs guard (C6-60 F1) and unknown-shape behavior unchanged
invariants_with_tests.I6: legacy_estimate_total_bytes untouched (M2 history anchor test unchanged)

affected_tests: tests/optimization_v6/memory/test_phase_memory_admission.py (26 tests): exact-byte accounting assertions recomputed under the recalibrated model with probe citations; semantic/structure assertions (differentiation, components charged, empty/unknown guards, reject policy) preserved in meaning
tests/unit/test_runtime.py (15 tests): child-env GDAL cap assertion updated to the min() semantics
tests/optimization_v8/dx/test_dx_surface.py (7 tests): reviewed; updated only where they price the simulation reservation

alternatives.A_per_shape_table: measured per-shape table + per-entry margin (B0 no-go fallback; not shape-general)
alternatives.B_gdal_only_reprice: cap the gdal component only, keep payload/live full-plane (REJECTED: payload+live alone = 1.63 GB > measured whole-child RSS 0.77 GiB; insufficient to admit 12x2)
alternatives.C_margin_2x: REJECTED by the login-refusal arithmetic above
alternatives.D_uncap_env_keep_price: leave GDAL_CACHEMAX at 5% and price observed use only (REJECTED: permitted envelope would exceed priced envelope; admission could under-price a future workload that fills the granted cache)

part_recalibration.review_gate: independent reviewer inspects the full diff (runtime_memory.py + runtime.py), the B0 fit, and the updated tests BEFORE the E2E runs; reviewer receives the evidence files and the invariants list, and is asked for counterexamples (workloads that could exceed the capped-cache envelope; shapes where the price under-covers measured RSS)

finalist_arms.primary: full chain at runtime_options(cpu_budget=24, workers=12, threads_per_worker=2) on the same frozen scene/asserts/bitwise gates as x01_b1
finalist_arms.secondary: workers=8, threads_per_worker=3, run in the same job ONLY IF the primary arm is refused admission at that job's live budget (refusal recorded)

part_e2e.bitwise: 24/24 SVF and 24/24 TMRT vs the same stored references used by x01_b1
part_e2e.timing: whole-chain wall vs the stored anchor 3838.3 s (= 1.723x vs S10-36); the SVF segment (unchanged 3x8 shape) is the GDAL-cap control vs the anchor 1271.7 s (barrier 352.2 + export stage 919.5)
part_e2e.run_count: ONE E2E run; a causal retry only for a documented infrastructure anomaly (campaign rule)
part_e2e.acceptance: bitwise pass AND measured chain < 3838.3 s AND admission verdict recorded; otherwise the candidate is recorded REJECTED with the full numbers and no shape change ships
part_e2e.projection_not_acceptance: 12x2 chain ~= 2123 s (~3.11x), 8x3 ~= 2430 s (~2.72x); the measured wall decides
